Howdy! I'm a fish biologist, data scientist, and current PhD candidate in Ecology and Environmental Science at the University of Maine.

My doctoral research follows cold-water fish living at the warm edge of their range: Maine's landlocked Arctic charr (*Salvelinus alpinus*), which are the southernmost populations in North America. I use acoustic telemetry, decades of mark-recapture data, and diet analysis to understand how these fish move, feed, and persist in a warming world.

You can read my CV [here](docs/GregKronisch CV.pdf).
